messages:
elaine: Heads up — client (NovaHealth) flagged two blockers on PO + DPA scope. Need legal + procurement input. PO shows Net30 but Finance wants Net45; DPA has PII + subprocessor clause they want tightened. Also signer mapping unclear for multiple LOBs. cc @matt_legal @cathy_procurement @sanjay_se

matt_legal: Got it. Can you paste the exact PO line that references payment terms? Also share the DPA excerpt.

elaine: PO line: `Payment Terms: Net30 from invoice date` — client asks Net45. DPA excerpt: `Section 6.3: Subprocessors may be engaged with prior notice` — they want explicit list + prior approval for named subprocs. They also want `Data Residency: EU only` for certain envs.

cathy_procurement: Finance prefers stick to Net30 unless customer covers extended days via credit hold. Suggest we offer Net45 for annual commitments > $150k. @elaine any committed ARR number for POC -> production?

elaine: PO is for POC pilot $25k, likely to convert to $200k ARR if POC results go well. Could do Net45 after conversion. For signature, client wants three signers: PO (procurement), SOW (engineering), MSA (legal). How to route in DocuSign?

docusign_bot: DocuSign workflow suggestion: envelope with three separate documents, routing order Proc -> Legal -> Engineering; or single envelope with signer roles assigned. See template `redwood_poc_multisig_v3`.

sanjay_se: Tech question — they requested `SLA: 99.9%` for POC env. We can't commit SLA on POC. Propose: `SLA: best-effort during trial; 99.9% committed upon Dedicated deployment`. Also POC data will be ephemeral, not subject to residency guarantees.

matt_legal: Agree with sanjay. For DPA subproc: we can provide an initial list and commit to notify for new subs; prior approval is doable for 'critical' subs only. I'll draft redlines: replace `prior approval` with `prior notice and right to object for critical subs`.

elaine: Can you drop redline by EOD? Customer wants countersign early next week. I'll ask them to mark PO as `PO-Temp` and add a clause `Pilot-specific terms`.

cathy_procurement: :thumbsup: I can approve Net45 conditional on clause: `Customer to provide purchase order with Net45 where applicable after conversion` — will add to the order form. Attaching sample clause: `PaymentTerms: "Net45 for pilot conversion, otherwise Net30"`

matt_legal: Uploading redline link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/secure/attachment/POC-DPA-redline.docx — tag me if you need changes. I'll also add audit log KMS text.

elaine: Thanks — loop me in on the Docusign template change. @docusign_bot can you create a draft envelope and mention routing order for review?

docusign_bot: Draft envelope created: https://docusign.com/envelopes/0xabc123. Routing order set Proc -> Legal -> Eng. Template `redwood_poc_multisig_v3` duplicated into workspace `sales-poc`.

cathy_procurement: One more: client legal asks for `SLA credit` mechanism in PO invoice schedule. Recommend 10% credit cap for POC failures. Thoughts?

sanjay_se: 10% cap for POC seems fine. We should state mitigation is best-effort since POC isn't on Dedicated infra.

elaine: Great. Let's get redlines in and I’ll coordinate countersign. I'll post final items tomorrow AM.
